notes:
Lead profile: early-stage SMB (ecommerce analytics SaaS). Small engineering team, ML team of 2. Signed up self-serve for hosted API; evaluating model choices for their chat+search features. Primary ask: guidance on choosing open/efficient models vs higher-quality heavy models.

Key product fit: want quick integration with hosted API (self-serve), predictable per-token cost, ability to route lower-cost variants for high-volume read-only search and higher-quality variants for user-facing chat. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching/cache) later.

Model selection questions (from CTO & ML lead):
- "Can you show tradeoffs between Llama 2/3 variants, Mistral 7B/Chat, and Qwen small/medium for our workload?"
- How much quality gain at 2x cost for our prompts? Any headroom using quantized variants on hosted API?
- Want rough latency numbers (p50/p95) for 512-token generation on public cloud regions (us-east/us-west) for each variant.
- Fallback policy ask: prefer auto-fallback from chat-quality to cheaper reranker when capacity/budget constrained. Want sample policy configs.

Requirements:
- Latency target: interactive chat p95 < 400ms is ideal but team says they can tolerate up to 800ms for complex completions. For search reranking need throughput 50 qps with p95 < 150ms.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget-conscious. Targeting <$0.10 per 1k prompt tokens across mixed workload. Will accept higher for chat if demonstrable lift.
- Models: prefer open-weight families (Llama/Mistral/Qwen) to avoid model access lock-in. Want clarity on versioning (2 vs 3) and known quality deltas on summarization and instruction-following.
- Security: public cloud ok, require SSO (SAML) and basic audit logs; will revisit residency if enterprise.

Sales notes (shorthand):
- CTO (Ravi) quoted: "We need better summaries than GPT-3.5 for long receipts — but can't blow budget."
- ML lead (Sofia) very hands-on; asked for prompt-engineered baseline + eval harness (we should provide small eval suite).
- AE action: provide cost-quality matrix, 1-2 example rollout configs (canary to cheaper model), sample eval pass/fail thresholds.

POC idea: run hosted API A/B for 2 weeks: variant A = Mistral-7B instruct (low-cost mid-quality) for search+rerank; variant B = Llama-3-small-chat for chat flows. Track answer quality vs token spend. Provide dashboard via Redwood Console.

Open items/Questions for Redwood:
- Confirm available hosted quantized variants and their price tiers (Qwen quantized? Llama 3 small/medium?).
- Provide sample latency numbers for 512/1024 tokens in us-east under 20 RPS sustained.
- Template for fallback routing rules and an example billing estimate for 50k monthly users.

Next steps (short):
- Send matrix + sample perf numbers (Maya) by 2026-02-18.
- Book technical deep-dive with Liam + Sofia (30m) Wk of 2026-02-22.
- Provide eval harness stub and suggested prompts (drive link).
